clue.text: Rat maybe tucking into a bit of butter? It may have a bearing on one's intake

definitions.text: It may have a bearing on one's intake

indicators.note: something tucked into something else sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

blocks.note: taken as written
a pat is a small slab of butter
a rat is an example of a pest

explanation.surface: A rodent burrowing into a pat of butter at the table, spoiling someone's meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rat' tempts you towards the deserter sense; it is just vermin. 'A bit of butter' does double duty as the article and the pat.
explanation.definitionFit: An appestat is the brain centre thought to regulate appetite, so it governs how much a person eats.
